releases.notes: New modules: Combo Counter, Reach Display, Memory Usage, Chat Stack (stacked repeats with counter), Statistics (local history graphs), Telemetry Block (on by default). Plus: self-updater with Updates dashboard tab (SHA-256 verified, staged restart), definition-driven config (plugin-ready), and two bugfix batches across HUD, dashboard and config. Pick the jar matching your game (26.1 / 26.2 / 26.3), Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.18+. Drop in mods and press K in game.

releases.notes:
Dev prerelease of 1.4.0. Pick the jar matching your game (26.1, 26.2 or 26.3), drop it in mods with Fabric Loader 0.18.0+ and Java 25.

New: Chat Stack (repeated chat lines collapse into an [xN] counter, prefix/suffix style, max stack setting), Combo / Reach / Memory / Statistics HUDs, dashboard + webroot updates.
Removed: Server Messages second-chat window (replaced by Chat Stack).

Not affiliated with Mojang/Microsoft. Use on servers at your own discretion.

releases.notes:
Stable 1.3.0. Pick the jar matching your game (26.1, 26.2 or 26.3), drop it in mods with Fabric Loader 0.18.0+ and Java 25.

New modules: ToggleSprint, ToggleSneak (vanilla-toggle drivers), Item Physics (tumble + flat rest), Autohide HUD (slide/shrink/pop per direction, speed, hotbar-only wake), Telemetry Block (default-on Mojang telemetry block).

Fixes: keybinds wiped on restart, TPS stuck at 20 (MSPT-based on singleplayer), zoom smoothing + base-FOV staleness, armor-box math, CPS/FPS format bugs, WS/config validation + clamping + rate limiting, per-field type isolation, config thread-safety, background-hex crash guards, hitbox translucency/labels/eye-lines, 60Hz drag previews, dashboard Reset-all/queue/counter/sync hardening.

Not affiliated with Mojang/Microsoft. Use on servers at your own discretion.
